title: 油价95美元：美联储两周后决策，下行风险为何更大？
speaker: Tai Hui

segments.en: The biggest background story for you recently is what obviously Jackson Hole speech but obviously the market pricing is sort of a reverse a little bit after Christopher Waller I think global markets are right now in a bit of a crossroads
segments.zh: 最近最大的背景事件显然是杰克逊霍尔演讲，但市场定价在沃勒讲话后有所反转。我认为全球市场正处于一个十字路口。

segments.en: they are searching for short-term tactical directions obviously there are positive and negatives in the market that can prepare that up and down on the positive and obviously the global macro fundamentals remain pretty resilient
segments.zh: 市场正在寻找短期方向，多空因素交织。积极的一面是，全球宏观基本面依然相当有韧性。

segments.en: culprit fundamentals exceptional you know which has had a mind-boggling strong second quarter in the US but between now and the third quarter it is a three-month gap so there's a bit of a vacuum of a positive news that can prepare a market higher
segments.zh: 美国第二季度表现强劲得令人难以置信，但距离第三季度数据还有三个月空窗期，因此缺乏推动市场上行的正面消息。

segments.en: on the negative side obviously use a higher inflation is sticky we have oil prices trading at around to 95 on the brand we are two weeks away from perhaps the most consequential and interesting fat decision of this year at least
segments.zh: 负面因素方面，通胀依然顽固，布伦特油价在95美元附近。距离今年最重要的美联储利率决策还有两周。

segments.en: and we are two months away from midterm elections so there are a lot of uncertainties confronting the market and my personal assessment is that maybe the downsides is a little bit greater than the upside so I think it pays to take a more cautious poster
segments.zh: 距离中期选举还有两个月，市场面临诸多不确定性。我个人评估，下行风险略大于上行，因此采取更谨慎的立场是值得的。
